Harborview Public Library

The Harborview Public Library is open Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 8 PM, and Saturday from 10 AM to 5 PM. It is closed on Sundays.

Our address is 214 Seabird Lane, Harborview, next to the ferry terminal.

Membership is free for all Harborview residents; bring one photo ID to sign up.
